subject: Joint success plan: PathoGenix evaluation & POC roadmap
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@pathogenix.com>, Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@pathogenix.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Joint success plan: PathoGenix evaluation & POC roadmap

Hi Emma / Carlos —

Thanks for the time today. As discussed, I attached a short Joint Success Plan (JSP) so we can align on what “success” looks like for the POC and who owns each piece. High level I captured:

- 3 target success criteria (latency, accuracy on canonical prompts, end-to-end cost per 1k tokens)
- Benchmark plan: seeded prompt set, blind eval metrics, and acceptance thresholds
- Owners: prompts & evaluation steward, infra & config contact, exec sponsor
- Timeline: 4-week evaluation with a mid-point sync and final handoff to Product Ops

Ask: can you confirm the internal stakeholders on your side (technical lead + procurement contact) and whether the proposed acceptance thresholds look reasonable?

I’ll loop Rishi for quantization/throughput questions and Marissa for renewal/contract prerequisites. Maya will run the prompt-vetting and bench harness with you.

Attached: px_joint_success_plan_v1.xlsx (MAP), prompt-benchmark-spec.md (detailed eval plan).

—
Logan Wright
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
From: Emma Jones <emma.jones@pathogenix.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@pathogenix.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 10:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Joint success plan: PathoGenix evaluation & POC roadmap

Logan —

Thanks for the doc and the clear framing. Quick answers:

- Internal stakeholders: Carlos (VP Eng) will be the technical owner, and I (Emma, Head of Data Science) will be the evaluation sponsor. Procurement contact is procurement@pathogenix.com (I’ll intro separately).
- Acceptance thresholds: the latency and cost targets look achievable. On accuracy, we need to add a secondary metric for hallucination rate on clinical prompts — I’ll add examples to the prompt set.

Next steps: please confirm week-1 ramp and the mid-point checkpoint you proposed (we prefer Wed of week 3). Also, does Redwood need a dataset export or can we run the benchmark via API-only?

Thanks,
Emma
Emma Jones
Head of Data Science | PathoGenix
emma.jones@pathogenix.com
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@pathogenix.com>, Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@pathogenix.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 13:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Joint success plan: PathoGenix evaluation & POC roadmap

Emma — great, thanks. Quick responses inline:

- Week-1 ramp: proposed start Monday May 24 (week 1) — we’ll provision a sandbox, share API keys scoped to the evaluation account, and run initial smoke tests.
- Mid-point checkpoint: Wednesday, June 9 (week 3) is fine — we’ll schedule a 30–45 min sync for results walkthrough and any config changes.
- Data access: API-only is preferred for us; we can run the benchmark against your prompt set without needing a dataset export. If you have sensitive examples you can redact before uploading.

Actions for Redwood:
- Maya: lead prompt vetting and benchmark harness (owner for prompt set + eval scripts).
- Rishi: confirm model/quantization recommendations for target throughput and cost.
- Marissa: lead contractual items and SOW checklist.

Carlos / Emma — can you please:
- Confirm procurement contact email (or intro)
- Share the initial prompt set by May 21 EOD so Maya can start seeding the harness

Thanks — I’ll update the JSP spreadsheet after your confirmation.

—
Logan
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@pathogenix.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Joint success plan: PathoGenix evaluation & POC roadmap

Hi Emma / Carlos —

I’ll take point on the prompt and benchmark workstream. High-level plan:

Week 0 (prep, May 24–28):
- Sandbox provisioned, API keys issued, sample prompt ingestion
- Define canonical prompt families (clinical-summarization, triage, lab-interpretation)

Week 1–2 (bench run):
- Run blind generation across seed set; collect token-level latency, per-prompt correctness, and hallucination flags
- Produce an evaluation matrix (accuracy, hallucination rate, latency p50/p95, cost per 1k tokens)

Week 3 (mid-point sync, June 9):
- Review preliminary results; if hallucination > threshold we’ll exercise calibrated decoding and rerun affected buckets

Week 4 (final, June 18):
- Deliver final report, artifacted prompts, and recommended runtime settings for Dedicated or Hosted paths

Please confirm the hallucination threshold you want to use (suggest <= 3% on clinical-summarization) and whether you have any additional prompt families to include. I’ll start drafting the bench harness and post the spec to the Drive link.

Attachments: prompt-benchmark-spec.md

—
Maya Srinivasan
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
maya.srinivasan@redwood.com
From: Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@pathogenix.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Jones <emma.jones@pathogenix.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Joint success plan: PathoGenix evaluation & POC roadmap

Thanks all — this looks good. Quick confirmations: procurement intro sent to Marissa (procurement@pathogenix.com). We’ll share the initial prompt set by EOD Monday (May 24).

On hallucination threshold: we’re comfortable starting with Maya’s suggestion (<= 3%) and will iterate if we see edge cases. Also, we want one extra deliverable: a short appendix showing failure modes with example prompts that triggered hallucinations — that will help our clinical reviewers.

Looking forward to the kickoff next week.

Best,
Carlos Ruiz
VP Engineering | PathoGenix
Attachments referenced: px_joint_success_plan_v1.xlsx (MAP spreadsheet), prompt-benchmark-spec.md (benchmark spec).
